verdict.justification: The project focuses on developing a web platform to support the knowledge management process in Colegio San Francisco de Asís, with the aim of creating a virtual community. The platform is intended to facilitate capturing, organizing, and storing knowledge that flows within the college, transforming it into an intellectual asset that can be shared with anyone. This will generate a virtual community that improves teacher-student relationships, promotes social interaction, encourages collaborative learning, and manages both teachers' and students' skills effectively.
